why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
answer: Both stand; they do not conflict. The outline (9.3.5.1.2.1) owns the shape: an outcome is {n, claim, writes_to, reads, after, via?}. The ticket is in the old falsifier-clauses shape, which the same outline line says every reader accepts during the change; the mechanical migration (aa3e9a70db47) moves it to the new field with clause 1 kept as outcome 1. writes_to and reads are not fillable at cast for a tester-cast 'reseals green' red, since nobody knows what the fix writes until it is diagnosed, so they are filled at the judgement step when the ticket is next opened for build, before BUILDME. Nothing in the outline changes; the ticket gains writes_to/reads at its build.
